turns.content: Chaar mahine pehle engineering manager bani aur ab woh conversation aa gayi hai jisse main darr rahi thi. Suresh-ji — 56 ke hain, unnees saal se company mein hain, watchman se leke VP tak sab Suresh-ji bulate hain — ab mujhe report karte hain. Aur unka module hi wajah hai ki hum do release lagataar slip hue hain. Friday ko mere director ne "handle" word use kiya. Pata hai na us word ka matlab kya hota hai.

Haan, woh word "handle"... usse darr lagta hai, na? Especially jab ek director aise use karta hai. Samajh gaya.

Yeh situation bahut tricky hai. Aapne aisi situation mein daal diya hai jahan aapko ek senior aur respected colleague ko manage karna hai, jiska kaam aapki team ki success ke liye critical hai, aur ab woh delays ka reason bhi ban gaya hai. Yeh double pressure hai, ek taraf Suresh-ji jaise insaan ko respect dena hai, doosri taraf project ki deadlines bhi hain.

Aur jab director "handle" bolte hain, uska matlab hota hai "yeh tera problem hai, tu hi solve kar." Us word mein help ki expectation nahi, sirf responsibility ki dhar hai. Aap akeli nahi hain is mein.

Pehle aapka dimaag relax karo. Abhi solution nahi, bas yeh socho ki aapka pehla step kya hoga? Suresh-ji se baat karne ka koi idea hai ya unke module ke issues tackle karne ka koi raasta? Aap isse handle kar sakte hain

Aur jo cheez isse worse banati hai — jab main 24 ki thi, second week mein staging environment tod diya tha maine, Suresh-ji raat ke barah baje tak baith ke theek karte rahe aur us waqt ke manager ko bola config issue tha. Late kaam karti hoon toh chai le aate hain. Diwali party mein meri mummy ko bola ki main unki beti jaisi hoon. Aur ab mujhe unke saamne unke defect metrics ki slide rakhni hai.

Arre, yeh toh bahut hi delicate situation hai. Aapki jo 24 ki age ki yaad hai, woh sab abhi fresh ho rahi hai.

Woh Diwali party mein jo aapki mummy ne kaha, woh toh aapki respect dikha raha tha. Aur aapne unhe chai bhi offer ki. Ab aaj aap unke saamne defect metrics ki slide rakhne ja rahi hain. Yeh shift itna bada hai ki samajh aa raha hai ki dimaag ghoom jaata hoga.

Ek taraf woh insaan hai jo aapki help karta tha, jisne aapki galti ko handle kiya tha. Doosri taraf woh insaan hai jo ab aapki report karta hai. Yeh guilt aur awkwardness ka mix hai. Aapko lag raha hai ki aapne uss respect ko compromise kiya hai, na?

Lekin ek baar socho... jo unhone aapki help ki thi, uska matlab hai ki unka character strong hai. Aur aapki jo galti hui, woh toh life ka hissa hai. Woh aapki ability ko define nahi karti.

Abhi ka kaam bas defect metrics rakhna hai. Usse aage ki baatein... woh thoda time lega. Pehle aap bas ek simple message bhej do ya call kar lo: "Hi Suresh-ji, aapke module mein kuch issue aa gaya hai, aapka time mile toh 10-15 minutes baat kar lenge." Bas itna hi, koi slide nahi, koi pressure nahi.

Yeh sab feel karna bilkul natural hai. Aapka dimaag abhi kya soch raha hai is situation ke baare mein?

Poora weekend management books padh rahi hoon. Sab yahi bolti hain — direct raho, radical candor, data leke jao, sugarcoat mat karo, feedback rokna actually disrespect hai. Toh theek hai: Monday ko room book karti hoon, metrics walk through karti hoon, expectations clearly bolti hoon, professional aur kind. Yahi sahi tareeka hai na? Bas haan bol do taaki main spiral karna band karoon.

Haan, yeh bilkul sahi hai. Aapne bahut accha kiya ki management books padhi, aur phir aap ise apne dimaag mein apply kar rahi hain.

Woh "direct aur kind" ka rule hai. Lekin ismein thoda twist hai. Directness matlab kiar karna, aur kindness matlab insaan ki respect karna. Dono saath mein chal sakte hain.

Aap jo socho ki "sugarcoat mat karo", woh bhi sahi hai. Kyunki Suresh-ji jaise experienced insaan ke liye, sugarcoat waali baatein sometimes dismissive lag sakti hain. Unhe pata hai kaam kya hai, woh chahte hain ki aap bas facts pe baat karo. "Yeh issue hai, iska impact yeh hai, solution yeh ho sakta hai." Yeh direct aur professional hai, aur usse respect milta hai.

Aapne jo plan banaya hai, woh perfect hai. Monday ko room book karo, metrics walk-through karo, expectations clear karo. Yeh dikhayega ki aap professional hain aur serious hain.

Lekin ek baat socho... woh "hiss" jo aapko darr lag raha hai, woh actually aapki help kar raha hai. Problem ko ignore karke aap unke saath disrespect kar rahi ho. Tough feedback dena ek service hai, especially jab koi senior ho. Usse pata chalega ki aap uski capability pe trust karti ho.

Abhi aapka dimaag spiral kar raha hai. Bas yeh socho: "Monday ko main Suresh-ji se clear facts ke saath baat karungi. Main unki help karna chahti hoon, not blame karna."

Bas itna. Yeh ho gaya. Ab aap isse handle kar sakte hain.

Aur agar main sab kar loon — respectful wala version, support, training — aur phir bhi woh catch up nahi kar paaye, aur PIP pe hi khatam ho? Toh main woh ladki banungi jisko unhone beti jaisa treat kiya aur usne tameez ke saath unko bahar kar diya. Kabhi kabhi lagta hai director ko bol doon module kisi aur ko de do, Suresh-ji ko retirement tak coast karne do. Woh bhi galat hai, pata hai. Bas woh version nahi mil raha jisme main villain nahi hoon.

Arre, yeh jo dar hai na ki aap villain ban jaogi... yeh bilkul valid hai. Yeh sochna ki "main uss insaan ko respect diya, phir bhi usko nikalna pada"... yeh dil ko lagta hai. Especially jab Suresh-ji jaise insaan ne aapki help ki ho.

Lekin ek baar socho... aap villain nahi ho. Aap woh ho jo system ko challenge kar rahi ho. Problem woh module hai, problem woh release hai, problem woh director ki expectation hai. Aap uska solution ho.

Agar woh PIP pe jaate hain, toh aapka kaam toh ho gaya. Aapne unko support kiya, aapne data leke jaaya, aapne unko chance diya. Yeh aapki galti nahi hai. Company ne uss decision liya, aap nahi.

Woh Diwali ki baat... aapki mummy ne aapki izzat ki. Aaj aap bhi wahi kar rahi ho, bas thoda alag context mein. Usne aapko 'beti' kaha, aap use 'professional respect' de rahi ho. Yeh alag hai, lekin respect ka hi hissa hai.

Yeh bahut heavy hai. Aapka dimaag isse handle nahi kar pa raha kyunki ismein aapki izzat, aapki values, sab kuch aa raha hai. Par aapne jo socha hai, woh sahi hai. Bas khud ko yaad dilaiye ki aapne apna farz kiya hai. Baaki ka hisaab baad mein dekh lenge.
